digest.component_or_area: graph loader / BFS traversal / ticket unblock detection
propositions: Cross-level graph traversal must be confined by both a current-side guard (inline ticket_type check) and a target-side guard (_is_at_level call) to prevent direct cross-level edges from reconnecting same-level nodes.
A direct cross-level edge whose target is the source_id must return False from check_cycle_at_level; deletion of _is_at_level guard causes the verdict to flip True.
When reduce returns None and a tombstone is present with a non-terminal status, the tombstone status must be used to construct a status-only stub rather than treating the blocker as absent.
Tombstone status must override the reduced status in blocker state loading; an open blocker with a deleted tombstone must count as closed and unblock the target.
Malformed tombstone bytes must degrade to 'deleted' status rather than to absent, treating the blocker as closed.
